_comment: Extraction-time character geometry edits for PLT fonts (fonts/extract_plt_fonts.py). Each group lists characters and a mode. 'height' maps the glyph's ink box exactly onto [-descent_percent%, 1000 + ascent_percent%] of the line height (capline - baseline, in the library design frame) by a vertical-only affine; AA arcs are refit natively (fonts/glyph_transforms.py). 'midline_center' purely translates the glyph so its ink-box centre lands on the midline (500 units); X, width and height are untouched. Both modes exempt the reference character (it defines baseline/capline) and rebuild bounding_box + both envelopes with the glyph. 'height' applies to non-symbol fonts only; 'midline_center' applies to every font (round-symmetric symbol slots sit low too). Opt out per mode with --no-vertical-centering / --no-height-prescriptions. Loaded by fonts/glyph_transforms.load_character_modifications.
